title: Alibaba Trials QwenBook AI Device, Team Size Around 150 People
excerpt: According to reports, the No-Image team under Alibaba Cloud is developing an AI device called QwenBook, positioned as a native intelligent agent computer, but i
content_html:
According to reports, the No-Image team under Alibaba Cloud is developing an AI device called QwenBook, positioned as a native intelligent agent computer, but its product form is more similar to the "Qwen Tablet." The product is currently in the early trial phase, focusing on office scenarios, and integrates models including Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-Flash.

According to an Alibaba Cloud insider, the product definition and hardware parts of QwenBook are independently developed by the team, while the team also brings in the system and end-cloud capabilities accumulated by No-Image in the cloud computer field. The current QwenBook team has about 150 people, with the system team mainly reorganized from No-Image and Alibaba Cloud OS teams, and the hardware team has recruited several talents from leading smartphone manufacturers.

From the product positioning perspective, QwenBook is not an AI feature upgrade of a traditional tablet computer, but rather attempts to use large models and intelligent agent capabilities as the core interaction method, integrating Alibaba's models, operating systems, and end-cloud collaboration capabilities into a new AI terminal. However, the product is still in the early stage, and the final form and specific launch plans have not been clarified yet.
